//==
// # Topology
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Concrete bodies for the adjacency tables

library Topology
{
    //==
    // # Concrete bodies for the adjacency tables
    //
    // The `IJagged` projections for the three CSR adjacency tables declared in
    // `topology.types.plato`. Each table already stores its boundaries in a
    // field literally named `Offsets`, so only the payload projection is written
    // here; the shared row vocabulary comes from `collections.library.plato`.

    //==
    // # Adjacency tables as IJagged rows
    //
    // Rows are the source elements (vertices, then faces); a row is that
    // element's neighbourhood run.

    // The neighbours of each vertex, packed vertex by vertex.
    Values(self: VertexAdjacency): Array<VertexIndex>
        => self.Neighbors;
